# Grok Build Qualified ACP Range

Captured 2026-07-30 after the operator provisioned normal Grok subscription
state.

Only exact installed `0.2.114` is qualified. Earlier inspected points remain
historical incompatible evidence. Uninspected intermediate points are not
inferred. Later stable observations may use explicit unverified-newer posture;
alpha or prerelease observations do not.

The npm launcher, npm channel tags, platform channel tags, ACP registry entry,
installed executable channel, ACP wire version, and Swallowtail behavior
qualification remain separate axes.
